title: Stay At Atop The Savannah | Our Beautiful Rosemary Beach Luxury Rental – Rosemary Beach®
meta_description: This two story unit offers a spacious interior, upscale docor, and modern appliances! Click to book Atop the Savannah today!
description_expanded:
Property includes dedicated Rosemary Beach® community Beach Access via 9 Private Beach Walkovers. Beach chair service available for an additional cost through RBPOA Beach Service. Complimentary access to Rosemary Beach® Fitness and complimentary court time at Rosemary Beach® Racquet Club also included.

The year-round sun and warmth of Florida makes it the perfect destination no matter what time of year you need to get away. The decision to head to Florida may be simple, but you'll need to plan where to go, the fun you'll have with family and friends, and where to stay. Florida's beautiful Emerald Coast is an option that will leave you with unforgettable memories, and choosing the Rosemary Beach® community means you'll be close to everything you want to do and see on the Emerald Coast. When you search for the perfect place to stay, you'll want something that extends the fun, excitement, and relaxation you look forward to.

Atop the Savannah is a three-bedroom, three-and-a-half-bathroom home with room for up to 8 guests in the property's 1,801 square feet. Everyone in the group will feel like they've stepped into a home away from home while also being close to all the restaurants, shops, and attractions you've come to experience.

THIS PROPERTY RENTS 7 NIGHTS - SATURDAY TO SATURDAY. NO DISCOUNTS

Highlights:

• Central A/C

• Master Bedroom (King)

• Viking Appliances

• Beautiful Furnishings and Finishes

• Multiple Restaurants & Shops Within Walking Distance!

Stylish Relaxation

Guest looking to relax in style will find all they desire in Atop the Savannah. Stylish furnishings and finishes can be found at every turn, in both the bedrooms and living spaces. Surrounding by the unique architecture of the Rosemary Beach community, Atop the Savannah is just moments away from the beach and crashing waves of the Gulf of Mexico. Enjoy exciting activities, bars, shops, beach gear, bike rentals, and countless other attractions to keep you busy during your stay.

Exterior Features

The two-story unit reflects relaxation the moment you arrive. The neutral exterior tones of the building highlight the darker trim tones such as those on the second-floor balcony. The expansive balcony features simple outdoor furnishings for you to relax and enjoy the beautiful Florida weather and sunsets and can be accessed from all of the bedrooms by its own door. Step out onto the covered first floor patio and sit in one of the chairs or just enjoy the beautiful Florida weather.

Interior Amenities

Make yourself at home in the spacious living area adjoining the kitchen. The living area features wood floors, comfortable furnishings, a fireplace, and flat screen TV. And accompanying DVDs, games, and stereo system. Relax on the couch or one of the chairs and read or spend time together. The dining area includes a wood dining table with seating for six. When you're hungry, make a delightful and delicious home-cooked meal in the kitchen, which features all stainless steel Viking appliances and everything you need for any meal. There are plenty of granite counter tops, including a raised bar with seating for four friends while the cook works their magic. Enjoy morning coffee, or a quick breakfast of a bagel or toast prepared in the provided toaster. Head upstairs to any of the three bedrooms for a nap or restful night's sleep. The master features a king bed, wood floors, and full bathroom with a deep tub, shower, and vanity. The second bedroom holds a king bed, a flat screen TV, and plenty of storage for your things. The en suite bath features an oversize shower and beautiful vanity. The third bedroom is perfect for the kids in the group, with wood floors, two sets of twin bunk beds, a TV with DVD player, and a nearby ¾ bath with shower.

Sleeping Accommodations, Sleeps 8

1st Level | Master Bedroom - King w/Full Bath

1st Level | Second Bedroom - King Bed w/ ¾ bath

1st Level | Third Bedroom - Two twin bunks w/ ¾ bath

Parking:

1 parking spot available behind building.

Things to Know:

• NO Pets

• Minimum Seven Night, Saturday-Saturday

• 2 complimentary adult bicycles

• Close to grocery store, beach, and many Rosemary Beach attractions and activities

• Community indoor pool

• Tennis

• Wi-Fi

• DVD Player w/DVD Library

Clean and Safe for Your Stay

Rosemary Beach is proud to provide all of its guests with clean and safe accommodations for the duration of your stay. All bedroom and bathroom linens and high-touch surfaces are thoroughly cleaned and disinfected between guests so you can be sure everything is clean and fresh.

Contact Us

No matter how long you plan to stay in Rosemary Beach, Atop the Savannah will give you all the rest, relaxation, and fun you're looking for. Contact us today to book your memorable stay that will have you coming back for years to come!

*Please note, when booking a winter monthly rental, access to the Fitness Center and Racquet Club is not included but can be added at those facilities.
